Variants.Content: Ax Castle is located in the Lorath Islands in the northern part of the Narrow Sea, and is politically within the route of the city-state of Lorath and its islands. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.
Entry Axe Keep Local families also rely on fishing, salt spray, stone harbors, fog routes, and entrepot trade; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.
Entry Axe Keep Entry Axe Keep

Entry Axe Keep They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the Loras; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.
Entry Axe Keep Entry Axe Keep

Entry Axe Keep If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Craftsmen saw stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs, and seams left by generations of repairs in Ax Castle. Priests guarded the robed monks, labyrinth ruins, and the islanders' tradition of loneliness. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Axe Keep They care about fishing, salt spray, stone harbors, shipping routes in the fog, and entrepot trade. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
